Lilac Mesh Top & Flare Jeans, Hands on Hips
Rights check / Repeats Study 147.
Source: 25027.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
falls past her shoulders and wears layered silver
necklaces. She wears a lilac long-sleeve mesh top with
a scoop neckline, a sheer lace-trimmed bodice, and a
center zip, over dark flare jeans with a wide
embellished metal belt. Her hands rest at her hips, and
her expression is calm. Soft, even studio light against a
plain white backdrop. Palette of lilac, charcoal denim,
and silver. Delicate and playful, in the style of a Y2K
lookbook.
Delicate, playful, Y2K
WORKING NOTES
- This is an alternate angle of the lilac mesh set in section
147; keep only one if you do not need both.
- The hands-on-hips pose is an alternative to the standing
pose.
